Name: Android Consolizer
Author: sonofskywalker3
Description:
[size=5][b]Android Consolizer[/b][/size]
Makes Android Stardew Valley's controller support work like the Nintendo Switch version. 90+ fixes across shops, inventory, chests, toolbar, Robin's building menu, Community Center bundles, furniture placement, every game menu tab — and the right-stick free cursor.
If you play on a handheld (Odin, Ayaneo, Retroid, etc.) or dock your phone/tablet to a TV, this mod makes the game actually playable without a touchscreen.

[b]🎉 Feature complete — v4.0.0.[/b] With the right stick now working like the Switch, Android Consolizer covers the full console control scheme, so I'm considering the mod [b]feature complete[/b]. If I missed something, let me know — I'll keep fixing any reported bugs, and I'll consider feature requests that bring it closer to full console parity.

[line]
[size=4][b]What's New in v4.0.0 — The Right Stick Update[/b][/size]
[b]The right stick is now the console free cursor[/b] — the last piece of the Switch control scheme that Android was missing. Every group is individually toggleable via GMCM.
[list]
[*][b]Right-stick cursor[/b] — the right stick moves an on-screen cursor that aims your tools, interaction, and placement at the tile under it, exactly like the Switch. Swing a tool and it hits the cursor's tile (diagonals included); move the cursor onto a chest or villager and the action targets it. The cursor auto-hides after ~4 seconds of no input, reverting tools to the tile you're facing.[/*]
[*][b]Contextual cursor[/b] — the cursor shows a hand over things you can grab or use (chests, the mailbox) and a magnifying glass over things you can inspect, like console.[/*]
[*][b]Place with the cursor[/b] — furniture, machines, and seeds place under the right-stick cursor; A places, B cancels.[/*]
[*][b]Tool-hit box follows through[/b] — the optional "always show tool hit location" box tracks the cursor while it's up and snaps back to your facing tile when it fades.[/*]
[*][b]Settings that stick[/b] — the in-game Zoom level and the tool-hit-location options now survive a full restart (Android wasn't saving them), and options you change with the controller are saved the same as touch.[/*]
[*][b]Snappier trigger toolbar[/b] — changing toolbar slots quickly with LT/RT no longer drops presses.[/*]
[*][b]Fertilizer shows a single target box[/b] — like seeds, instead of the screen-wide green map.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Previous releases[/b][/size]
Full version history is in the GitHub repo's docs/CHANGELOG.md. Recent highlights: [b]v3.9.0 — Console Parity: Big Systems[/b] (charge tools while moving, console slingshot aiming, drop blocker, restored Options + working zoom, dialogue choice boxes); [b]v3.8.0 — Console Parity: Quick Wins[/b] (resizable toolbar, museum donations, geode breaking, Load Game/title cursors, multi-page mail, and more).

[line]
[size=4][b]Controller Layout Support[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Switch/Odin[/b]: A=right, B=bottom, X=top, Y=left[/*]
[*][b]Xbox[/b]: A=bottom, B=right, X=left, Y=top[/*]
[*][b]PlayStation[/b]: Cross=A, Circle=B, Square=X, Triangle=Y[/*]
[/list]Two control styles:
[list]
[*][b]Switch style[/b]: Right button confirms, bottom cancels[/*]
[*][b]Xbox/PS style[/b]: Bottom button confirms, right cancels[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Toolbar (Console-Style)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]12-slot toolbar rows instead of Android's chaotic scrolling[/*]
[*]LB/RB switches between rows (up to 3 with full backpack)[/*]
[*]LT/RT moves left/right within the current row[/*]
[*]Visual toolbar matches console layout[/*]
[*]Picked-up items land in the row you're currently viewing[/*]
[*]Resizable via the Options "Toolbar Slot Size" slider (capped to fit the screen); "Toolbar Padding" lifts it off the edge[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Shops[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A button purchases on buy tab, sells entire stack on sell tab[/*]
[*]Y button sells one item (hold for rapid sell)[/*]
[*]LB/RB adjusts purchase quantity (hold to repeat)[/*]
[*]Right stick jumps 5 items at a time (hold to repeat)[/*]
[*]Y button icon shows tab-switch hint (adapts to controller layout)[/*]
[*]Sell price tooltip with gold coin icon next to selected item[/*]
[*]Non-sellable items (0g) greyed out on sell tab[/*]
[*]Visible cursor on both buy and sell tabs[/*]
[*]Buy list holds its scroll position after a purchase[/*]
[*]Works with every shop: Pierre, Robin, Marnie, Blacksmith upgrades, Desert Trader, recipes, Joja, dressers, aquariums, and more[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Chests (Console-Style)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A transfers full stack between chest and inventory (instant, no selection step)[/*]
[*]Y transfers one item (hold for rapid transfer)[/*]
[*]X sorts chest contents[/*]
[*]RB snaps to Fill Stacks button[/*]
[*]All sidebar buttons reachable: Sort, Fill Stacks, Color Toggle, Sort Inventory, Trash, Close[/*]
[*]Full 7x3 color picker swatch navigation, B closes picker only (not the chest)[/*]
[*]Swap system when inventory is full — A picks up for displacement, place anywhere, B cancels[/*]
[*]X button deletion bug completely blocked (your iridium tools are safe)[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Inventory (Console-Style)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A picks up entire stack to cursor, A again places or swaps[/*]
[*]Y picks up a single item from a stack (hold for continuous)[/*]
[*]X sorts inventory[/*]
[*]Held items render visually at cursor slot[/*]
[*]Tooltips on hover, equipment slot tooltips (hat, rings, boots, etc.)[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Shipping Bin[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A ships entire stack from selected slot[/*]
[*]Y ships one item[/*]
[*]"Last shipped" display updates properly[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Gameplay (Console-Style)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Charge an upgraded Hoe or Watering Can while walking — hold the tool button and move to charge its area effect, release to fire, instead of rapid-firing single uses and stopping in place[/*]
[*]Slingshot: move freely with it equipped, hold the tool button to draw and aim with the left stick, release to fire once (Switch-style direct aim)[/*]
[*]Drop blocker — you can't instantly re-grab an item you just dropped; the game's own short pickup delay engages, like console (monster loot and harvested crops unaffected)[/*]
[*]Optional "always show tool hit location" box — the tile your hoe/can/pickaxe/axe will hit (toggled on the Options page); it follows the right-stick cursor and snaps back to your facing tile when the cursor fades[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Right Stick (Console Cursor)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The right stick moves an on-screen cursor in the overworld, exactly like the Switch — it aims tool swings, tile interaction, and item placement at the tile under it (diagonals included)[/*]
[*]Contextual sprite: a hand over interactables (chests, the mailbox) and a magnifying glass over things you can inspect[/*]
[*]Auto-hides ~4 seconds after the last stick input, reverting tools to the tile you're facing[/*]
[*]Furniture, machine, and seed placement ghosts follow the cursor; A places, B cancels[/*]
[*]Toggleable (Right Stick Cursor); when off, the right stick is zeroed in the overworld (no cursor drift)[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Furniture Placement[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Single ghost rectangle shows exactly where the furniture will land[/*]
[*]Translucent furniture sprite rendered over the placement target — matches console[/*]
[*]Single-tile placement ghost for craftables too (sprinklers, machines)[/*]
[*]Seeds and fertilizer show a single red/green target box, not the touch-style screen-wide green map[/*]
[*]Bed placement no longer bounces back to inventory[/*]
[*]Y no longer rapid-toggles — one press = one interaction[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Robin's Building Menu[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Menu no longer instantly closes when opened with controller[/*]
[*]Full joystick control in farm view — left stick moves cursor, pans viewport at edges[/*]
[*]Build mode: A confirms placement at cursor position[/*]
[*]Move mode: A selects building, move cursor, A confirms new location[/*]
[*]Demolish mode: A highlights building (green), A again confirms. Move off to deselect safely.[/*]
[*]Building skin picker navigable with controller[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Community Center Bundles[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Bundle overview: D-pad/thumbstick navigates bundles, A opens donation page[/*]
[*]Cursor remembers your position when returning from donation page[/*]
[*]Donation page: Navigate 6-column inventory grid, A donates items; ineligible items greyed out[/*]
[*]Navigate right into ingredient list to see what each slot needs[/*]
[*]Vault bundles: A on purchase button pays for the bundle[/*]
[*]Bundle rewards: Navigate to present, A opens rewards, A takes stacks[/*]
[*]Custom cursor drawn (Android suppresses the default one here)[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Museum & Geodes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Museum: visible cursor, D-pad selection, A donates artifacts; rearrange the layout with full grid navigation[/*]
[*]Geode menu: single A-press cracks, selected geode auto-highlighted with tooltip, spatial navigation between geodes[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Title & Menus[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Load Game and title screens: visible cursor + snap navigation (slot select, scroll, delete-confirmation dialog)[/*]
[*]Adventurer's Guild monster eradication list and multi-page mail fully navigable[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Game Menu Tabs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Social[/b]: Navigate villager list, right stick fast scroll, A opens gift log, LB/RB switches villagers in gift log[/*]
[*][b]Collections[/b]: Grid navigation across items and sub-tabs, finger cursor[/*]
[*][b]Crafting[/b]: Finger cursor replaces red highlight; hold A to craft continuously[/*]
[*][b]Skills[/b]: Grid navigation across skill icons and level bars[/*]
[*][b]Animals[/b]: Navigate animal list[/*]
[*][b]Powers[/b]: Finger cursor replaces glow highlight[/*]
[*][b]Options[/b]: Left stick navigates, A activates, right stick scrolls, dropdowns work; plus the restored "tool hit location" checkboxes and a working Zoom Level slider, with touch-only joypad options hidden under a controller[/*]
[*][b]LT/RT[/b] switches between all tabs (console parity)[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Other Fixes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Fishing rod bait/tackle: A picks up bait/tackle, Y on rod attaches or detaches[/*]
[*]Slingshot ammo: Same pattern — A picks up ammo, Y on slingshot attaches/detaches[/*]
[*]Cutscene skip: Press Start twice during skippable cutscenes[/*]
[*]Start button: Tap = Game Menu, Hold ~½ sec = Quest Log/Journal[/*]
[*]Dialogue choice boxes open on the first option with a red outline + finger cursor (console look, no yellow highlight)[/*]
[*]Settings persistence: the in-game Zoom level and the tool-hit-location options survive a full restart, and options changed with the controller are saved the same as touch[/*]
[*]GMCM controller navigation via our [url=https://github.com/sonofskywalker3/GenericModConfigMenu]controller-enabled GMCM fork[/url][/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Bumper Mode[/b][/size]
For controllers where triggers aren't detected (e.g. Xbox via Bluetooth):
[list]
[*]D-Pad Up/Down switches toolbar rows, LB/RB moves within row[/*]
[*]LB/RB adjusts shop purchase quantity[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Tested Controllers[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]AYN Odin Pro[/b] (built-in) — Fully working[/*]
[*][b]Ayaneo Pocket Air Mini[/b] (built-in) — Fully working[/*]
[*][b]EasySMX S10[/b] on tablet — Fully working[/*]
[*][b]Gamesir X2[/b] — Fully working (digital triggers)[/*]
[*][b]Nintendo Switch Pro[/b] — Working (digital triggers supported as of v3.8.4; may need Controller Layout = Xbox on some Android devices — see the v3.8.4 note above)[/*]
[*][b]Xbox Bluetooth[/b] — Working (triggers need bumper mode)[/*]
[*][b]Logitech G Cloud[/b] — Fully working (primary test device)[/*]
[/list]If you test on other hardware, let me know!

[line]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Every feature is individually toggleable via [url=https://github.com/sonofskywalker3/GenericModConfigMenu/releases]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or config.json:
[list]
[*]Controller Layout (Switch / Xbox / PlayStation)[/*]
[*]Control Style (Switch-style or Xbox-style confirm/cancel)[/*]
[*]Console Chests (sorting, transfer, color picker, sidebar)[/*]
[*]Console Shops (A purchases, quantity control, sell tab)[/*]
[*]Console Toolbar (12-slot rows, bumper/trigger switching)[/*]
[*]Console Inventory (A/Y item management, bait/tackle)[/*]
[*]Console Shipping (A/Y ship controls)[/*]
[*]Console Menus (all game menu tab navigation)[/*]
[*]Console Furniture Placement (single ghost rectangle, craftables + seeds too)[/*]
[*]Console Museum Donation + Geode menus[/*]
[*]Move While Charging (charge Hoe/Watering Can while walking)[/*]
[*]Console Slingshot Aim[/*]
[*]Console Drop Blocker[/*]
[*]Console Dialogue Cursor[/*]
[*]Pickup To Active Row[/*]
[*]Hold To Craft[/*]
[*]Right Stick Cursor[/*]
[*]Carpenter Menu Fix[/*]
[*]Furniture Debounce[/*]
[*]Hold Start for Quest Log[/*]
[*]Bumper Mode[/*]
[*]And more[/*]
[/list](Zoom level and the tool-hit-location checkboxes live on the in-game Options page and now persist across restarts.)
